facades.name: north front, east module
facades.note: w01-360 (2025-10-01, 25.3 px/m, the lower 21.5 m of the crop = 24.7 m of model at the north front's x1.15): plinth bays between stone piers every 5.42 m, six below (the second a dark door bay) and five above (the second bay is a closed dark panel); then five storeys of ten French windows: a group of five, blank brick, a group of five with stone ledges starting with a narrow 0.66 m window.

facades.name: west wing front
facades.note: tall/w02-0 (2021-07-07, 25 px/m, heights x0.893 to the 3DBAG roof): the wing starts 13.3 m from the north corner (the tower is 13.3 m deep on this front). Ground six shop windows, the garage entrance, three garage doors and two doors; the stone first storey eleven French windows (none under the first column); the glazed hotel storey along the north half plus four windows south of it; four brick storeys of twelve French windows every 4.5 m. depthBand 3.2 keeps the 3 m deep garage entrance. The two loggia storeys above 22 m are outside the band.
